errors.text_span: 水平轴代表刻板印象程度
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is labeled "仇恨程度" (Degree of Hate), not "刻板印象程度" (Degree of Stereotype).
The y-axis does not have a specified unit. The unit "份数" (copies/portions) is hallucinated.
The y-axis has tick marks at intervals of 20, not 10.

errors.text_span: “有”的情况的柱状图高度约为20份，而 “无”的情况大约为70份
errors.evidence: For category 1, the value for "有" (orange bar) is approximately 10, not 20. The value for "无" (blue bar) is approximately 158, not 70.
For category 2, the value for "无" (blue bar) is approximately 70, not 80.

errors.text_span: “有”的情况的柱状图高度约为75份，而 “无”的情况大约为85份

For category 4, the value for "无" (blue bar) is approximately 108, not 150.
